body:
**Added in daffdd4: two more machines**, from manuals the contributor supplied.

**Tormach 1100M** (`tormach-1100m.mch`), from UM10540 v0626A.

| Figure | Value | Page |
|---|---|---|
| Travel | 18 × 11 × 16.25 in | pp. 33, 119 |
| Spindle | 70–7500 rpm | pp. 32–33 |
| Belt ranges | 70–2000 / 250–7500 rpm | pp. 32, 119, 192 |
| Power | 1.5 kW (2 hp) | pp. 32–33 |
| Max feed X, Y / Z | 110 / 90 IPM | pp. 32–33 |
| Taper | R8 | p. 33 |
| Coolant | M7 / M8 | p. 245 |
| Rigid tapping | **false** | p. 33 |

The thread-machining line reads "Tension/Compression, Auto-Reversing, Thread Mill", word for word the 770M's, and its G84 (p. 241) is a holder cycle. G33.1 appears only in PathPilot's generic G-code table (p. 224) and is never claimed for this machine. This file matches PathPilot Hub's "1100M" simulator.

**Tormach PCNC 770** (`tormach-pcnc770.mch`, pre-Series-3), from 31725 Rev B1-4. Every figure was re-read from B1-4. It differs from Series 3 only in its 130 IPM X/Y rapid (Series 3 gives 135).

**1100M+:** UM10540 never mentions it, so it has no file.

With these, every model in the issue title is covered, so this PR now **Fixes #170** (commit daffdd4).

**Spindle limit check:** a sample job with 9500/10000 rpm tools is refused on the 1100M by name ("runs 9500 rpm, above the machine's 7500"). At 7000/7500 rpm it posts with the HIGH belt note.

**Quick gate:** upstream/main merged (clean). post, sim and app are green. The remaining reds also fail on main: `swarf_pose_continuity` (#351) and the GPU headless tests.

Still a draft: the contributor's Hub run (1100M simulator) and GUI check are pending.

**Contributor's hands-on check (PathPilot Hub v2.14.4, plus the GUI on a release build of daffdd4):**

- **`sample-1100m.nc`**, a 3-op job (face, circular hole, 2D contour; G54 on the stock top) on the **Tormach 1100M** at 7000/7500 rpm, run in Hub's **1100M** simulator. It ran clean to `M30`: 2180 lines, cycle time 1:32, HI belt, no alarms.
- **`sample-pcnc770.nc`**, the same job on the **PCNC 770 (Series 3)** at 9500/10000 rpm, run in Hub's **770M** simulator, the closest available. It ran clean to `M30`: 2180 lines, 1:05, HI belt.
- **GUI:** Setup → Machine → Library lists all six new machines alongside the existing ones, and each one loads.
- **Refusals:** editing the 1100M sample's T1 to 9500 rpm makes post refuse; the first refusal is the stale toolpath ("inputs moved since generation"). By MCP on the regenerated job, the same edit is refused with "runs 9500 rpm, above the machine's 7500".

Merges cleanly with main. Flagging ready.

<!-- review-cost: estimated -->
**Estimated agent cost:** ~$1.13 (rough estimate from size: 486 changed lines)

No token usage was recorded for this PR, so this is calibrated from PRs with measured cost (our fix PRs, fix agent + review: median ~$1.20, ~$2.33 per 1,000 changed lines; floor $0.15, cap ~$3.60). For a contributor's PR it estimates what writing and reviewing it the way our agents work would cost, not what their session actually spent.

Blended upper estimate: 90 % input / 10 % output at list price (Opus 5.5 ~$5.60/M, Sonnet 5.5 ~$2.80/M, Haiku 5.5 ~$0.14/M). Cache reads make the real cost lower; main-session coordination isn't counted.
